$description: One entry per distinct real page SHAPE observed in src/pages/. Every real route (src/router.js ROUTES, 8 entries) maps to exactly one template. Chrome (shell.navbar, shell.footer) is rendered unconditionally around every page by src/App.jsx and is therefore present in every template's node list.
measuredFrom: src/App.jsx (PAGES map, unconditional Navbar+Page+Footer wrapping), src/router.js (ROUTES array), each src/pages/*/index.jsx

template.home.description: The marketing homepage: full-length scroll-driven product story from hero through final conversion CTA. The only route using the dedicated conversion.pricing-cta section and NOT showing conversion.footer-cta (cta:false in App.jsx PAGES map).

template.chat.description: Product-specific landing page for the Chat feature: hero demo + 3-scenario proof grid.

template.enterprise.description: Enterprise sales-motion landing page: hero routing to sales + trust/security FAQ. No self-serve download CTA and no footer-cta banner (cta:false in App.jsx PAGES map, matching the sales-only conversion path).

template.pricing.description: Full pricing page: plan tiers, single-quote proof, comparison table, FAQ, resources, tweet wall, and logo marquee. The richest template by section count (7 real sections).

template.blog-index.description: A single filterable post-list page. Structurally distinct from template.article (this is a listing/filter UI, not prose) — confirmed by reading S01Blog.jsx directly (chip filter + grid, useBlogListFilter), not assumed from the 'Blog' name alone.

template.article.description: A single long-form blog article: byline, date, share, and prose body. Structurally distinct from template.blog-index (confirmed by reading S01GranolaForApple.jsx directly: article/byline/prose shape, not a list+filter shape).

template.careers.description: A single multi-zone careers page (hero, category-grouped openings, team proof) built as one continuous section rather than a composed sequence of the smaller marketing sections.

template.contact-form.description: A minimal single-purpose lead-capture page: headline + embedded third-party form, no other marketing content.
